conflict: Both sides are sourceable. (A) 'will likely be out for most or all of the 2026-27 season' - CBS Sports, https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/donte-divincenzo-achilles-injury-timberwolves-nuggets/ - this agrees with the internal project doc dated 2026-07-17. (B) 'a return sometime around late February, perhaps just after the 2027 All-Star break, becomes a realistic target for next season' - Heavy, 2026-04-26, https://heavy.com/sports/nba/minnesota-timberwolves/donte-divincenzo-injury-update-return-timeline-reset/ - explicitly conditional on matching Tatum's 298-day post-surgery arc, so it is a projection, not a team or medical timeline. Partially corroborating (B): 'Several within the Timberwolves organization believe DiVincenzo could return at some point next season' - SI/OnSI, 2026-05-28, https://www.si.com/nba/timberwolves/onsi/donte-divincenzo-s-recovery-looms-large-over-timberwolves-offseason-plans . Resolution I recommend: treat (A) as the base case and (B) as the upside tail, because (A) is what the club's own conduct implies (no timeline set as of July) and (B) is a media extrapolation from a single comparable.
